title: Place the note
summary: A note tapped onto an empty staff, checked by pitch and octave.
content:
## Lines and spaces

On a treble staff the lines from the bottom are E, G, B, D and F, and the spaces between them are F, A, C and E. G sits on the second line, where the clef curls.

## Ledger lines

Middle C sits on a short line of its own: one ledger line below the treble staff, or one above the bass staff.

## Sharps and flats

A sharp raises a note by a half step and a flat lowers it. F sharp is written on the F line or space with a sharp sign in front.

quiz.explanation: G sits on the second line of the treble staff, where the clef curls.

quiz.prompt: Place middle C on the bass staff.
quiz.explanation: Middle C sits on one ledger line above the bass staff.

quiz.prompt: Place an F sharp, in any octave.
quiz.explanation: F sharp is an F with a sharp in front: the bottom space or the top line of the treble staff.
